Who We Are

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Voice AI Team.

On the Voice AI Team, our mission is to build and operate the voice platform that powers Toast and to ship novel applications on top of it that create real value across Toast's customer base. This is a greenfield space where the platform and its use cases are being defined together, and the work you do here will be foundational to how Toast uses voice AI for years to come.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll take ownership of significant projects end-to-end: designing systems, driving execution across the team, and making the technical decisions that shape how the platform grows. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and stakeholders across Toast to turn ambiguous problems into reliable, scalable systems. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable backend services and applications supporting Toast's Voice AI platform
Lead complex, cross-cutting projects from design through production, owning outcomes and driving alignment across stakeholders
Shape the team's technical direction by making architectural decisions, defining patterns, and reducing complexity for the engineers around you
Build and evolve integrations with AI platforms and internal Toast systems, making pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, reliability, and long-term scalability
Design and implement observability, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI-powered systems, using production data to understand and continuously improve system behavior
Advocate for engineering quality and best practices, raising the bar for the team and the broader organization
Mentor engineers at all levels through code reviews, design feedback, and technical guidance

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

5+ years of experience with object-oriented languages such as Java or Kotlin
Basic familiarity with frontend development on small scale projects
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
Experience shipping complex, mission-critical production services and owning them long-term
Track record of leading multi-person projects end-to-end, from design through rollout
Deep understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and production reliability
Experience building and reasoning about AI-powered systems, including nondeterminism, evaluation strategies, observability, and cost management
Experience developing AI-integrated products or features, with a practical understanding of how to ship and iterate on systems that incorporate LLMs or other AI capabilities
Strong cross-team communication and collaboration skills; able to influence direction without formal authority
Actively uses AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) in day-to-day development
Experience with voice or conversational AI platforms is a plus, but not required

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written in Kotlin and Java using DropWizard, running on AWS (DynamoDB, RDS, Lambda). We store data in sharded Postgres databases and have our own platform for user management, canary deployments, and load balancing. Our web front-end is built with React and ES6.

About Toast

Our focus is on building the platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we'll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future. We build experiences that help make operating and growing a business and delighting customers easier and scalable. It's why tens of thousands of businesses love Toast.

Toast IQ is our AI assistant, designed to give restaurant operators smarter insights, deeper personalization, and the ability to take action across the Toast ecosystem. Building on this foundation, we're investing heavily in agentic capabilities by giving operators the ability to delegate real work to Toast IQ, not just view insights.

We're entering an exciting phase of expanding this product to tens of thousands of businesses. That expansion depends on getting the core interaction patterns right once, and getting the whole company aligned behind them. That's where you come in.

 

About this role

As the Principal Product Designer for Toast IQ Core, you will define the interaction language for agentic experiences at Toast including the patterns, behaviors, and components that every team building on top of Toast IQ will use. This isn't a single-surface design role. Your job is to figure out what "good" looks like when a restaurant operator moves from viewing a dashboard to delegating work to an AI agent, and then to get product, engineering, and design teams across the company to build on that foundation instead of inventing their own.

You'll set direction hands-on, in Figma, in prototypes, in critique, and through influence: building the conviction and relationships needed for other teams to adopt a pattern language you define, not just execute your own roadmap. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, data science, go-to-market, and conversational and service designers to define the future of intelligence at Toast.

This is a highly visible, individual-contributor role for someone who wants outsized leverage over how an entire product area feels and works.

Case studies that show you defining a new interaction paradigm, not just refining an existing one, and driving adoption of it beyond your own team or product surface. We're evaluating systems thinking and organizational influence as much as visual craft.

You are a dynamic leader with proven impact in previous roles who is ready and willing to take on new challenges! You’re excited to join the remotely distributed group of product designers, user researchers, design ops leaders, and product managers that compose the Toast Design team. You have a founder’s mentality: and exhibit ownership of outcomes over outputs. You own the quality and outcomes associated with full end to end experiences.

The Kitchen Operations team owns one of Toast's most operationally critical and strategically exciting products: the Kitchen Display System (KDS). Deployed across tens of thousands of restaurants, Toast KDS is the connective tissue between front-of-house and back-of-house, routing tickets to the right prep stations, managing order sequencing, and helping kitchens run fast and accurately under pressure. KDS has strong growth across SMB, enterprise, and international segments.

Our vision is KDS in the vast majority of Toast kitchens within the next few years. Getting there means three things: supporting the most sophisticated enterprise kitchen workflows in the market, differentiating through kitchen data and AI-powered operational insights, and growing adoption among the restaurants that still run on paper tickets.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of restaurant operations, hardware-software product, and applied AI. You'll shape how hundreds of thousands of kitchen workers run their stations every day — and you'll be the one building the data and agent layer that lets kitchens run smarter, not just faster.

Define where agentic AI creates real value in the kitchen: proactive prep time adjustments based on real-time order load, automatic kitchen configuration changes tied to labor schedules or ordering channel mix, intelligent ticket routing and load balancing — and build the investment case to pursue the highest-leverage bets.
Own KDS delivery end-to-end, working directly with large restaurant groups to translate complex, high-stakes workflow requirements into scalable product decisions that serve the whole market.

Shape and validate the business case for the next-generation KDS strategy — the long-horizon bets that drive future growth.
